provider: HKU Faculty of Science 2026 BSc&MRes and Intensive Major syllabuses
note: The current official BSc&MRes syllabus, updated on 24 July 2026, requires 240 BSc credits plus 63 MRes credits (303 total). Each of the seven Programme records combines its complete current 144-150 credit Intensive Major code list with the shared MRes core, current Faculty Research Postgraduate elective pool and 42-credit research project. The named Programme-specific coded components are complete. Open UG5/Common Core/free-elective pools are excluded because they are not closed Programme-specific course lists. Science Foundation exemptions, accreditation conditions, Physics theme specialisations, exchange equivalences and any cross-degree counting require manual confirmation and are not presented as automatic graduation decisions.
